text:
devon: heads-up — rolling deploy for model-route v2 starts in 30m. plan is gradual flag ramp for `model_route_v2` 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. tagging @maya @ops_liz for watches

maya: ack. i'll be on perf dashboard and trace. set alerts for 99p latency + error rate >0.4% :eyes:

deploybot: scheduled toggle: 
```
2026-03-21T15:00:00Z -> model_route_v2: enable 5%
2026-03-21T15:15:00Z -> 25%
2026-03-21T15:30:00Z -> 50%
2026-03-21T15:45:00Z -> 100%
```
deployment id: db-1753219876

ops_liz: attaching quick rollback criteria so it's clear: 
- error_rate (5m) > 0.5% OR
- 99p latency increase > 150ms vs baseline OR
- CPU on redwood-dedicated-pool > 85% for 10m
If triggered -> deploybot auto-rollbacks enabled, and team will pin `model_route` -> `v1-stable`

devon: noted. i'm adding release note in the change window doc and will post link when ready. Also: can we mute non-critical alerts during the 5m stabilize windows?

maya: yes please mute alert `low-sev-telemetry` for the next 60m. keep sev>=2 live. i'll handle paging thresholds.

deploybot: mute applied: `low-sev-telemetry` until 2026-03-21T16:20:00Z by ops_liz request

sam: quick question — if we hit a partial regress and rollback is needed, do we prefer fast rollback (drain + switch) or slow drain?

ops_liz: prefer fast rollback for this route because sessions are stateless. steps: 1) deploybot: drain 30s, switch to `v1-stable` flag pin, 2) alert channel, 3) create rollback ticket. keep logs of any failed inferences.

devon: adding a canary extra check at 15m: run smoke evals against golden prompt set (saved in /evals/route_v2_smoke). will post results here. If regression on top-1 accuracy > 2% -> rollback.

maya: perfect. i'll watch eval results + tail logs.

deploybot: smoke eval scheduled at 2026-03-21T15:15:30Z, results will be posted to this thread

deploybot: smoke eval results: 15m canary -> PASS. top-1 delta: +0.1% (ok). 99p latency delta: +30ms. monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:

devon: thanks. proceeding with 25% at 15:15.

maya: seeing a small bump in p95 but within expected. keeping eyes.

deploybot: ramp to 25% completed at 2026-03-21T15:15:10Z

ops_liz: reminder — if we hit err > 0.5% the bot will auto-rollback. everyone stay ready for a manual override if needed. :exclamation:

sam: i'm here and ready to run the rollback script if necessary.

devon: good run so far. will update change window doc with final rollout time once 100% completes.

deploybot: 100% completed at 2026-03-21T15:46:00Z. no rollback triggered. closing rollout, unmuting alerts. :tada:
